limitations: Trained on simulation only. Real collision data carries no truth label, so a score on measured data cannot be verified.
Signal is gluon-gluon fusion production only; VBF, VH and ttH are not included.
Background is the irreducible ZZ->4l only. Fake and non-prompt leptons, which dominate real data before selection, are not modelled.
m_4l is deliberately excluded from the features to avoid sculpting the mass spectrum.
Score is a discriminant, not a probability: the training class balance is a choice, not a physical prior.
Background N_eff in the 115-130 GeV window is 14, a ~27% uncertainty. Significance differences are not resolvable.
